# US-003: Find files by search or folder

## User Story

As a Client, I want to search files and filter by folder, so that I find a file quickly.

## Context

"Search files..." (L84); folder cards (L52–L72).

## Linked Requirements

| FR | Priority | Notes |
|----|----------|-------|
| [FR-project-files-010](../srs/project-files-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P0 | Search |
| [FR-project-files-012](../srs/project-files-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P1 | Folder filter (inferred) |

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — Search by name

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-project-files-010
- **Screen:** project-files

```gherkin
Given files "711_Scope of Work.docx" and "711_Brand Assets_V1.mp4"
When the user searches "Scope"
Then only "711_Scope of Work.docx" is listed
```

### AC-002 — No result

- **Type:** error-path
- **Covers:** FR-project-files-010
- **Screen:** project-files-empty
- **Error code:** E-project-files-002

```gherkin
Given no file matches "xyz"
When the user searches "xyz"
Then the table is empty and E-project-files-002 is shown (wording TBD)
```

### AC-003 — Folder filter

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-project-files-012
- **Screen:** project-files

```gherkin
Given files in Proposal and Material
When the user selects the Material folder card (behaviour TBD)
Then only Material files are listed
```
